update.column: SELECT ml.id as "Préstamo", mc.name as "Seguro endosado", mlc.insurance_name as "Nombre aseguradora", mlc.insurance_id as "Nit aseguradora", TO_CHAR(mlc.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as "Fecha de vencimiento de la póliza" FROM m_loan ml INNER JOIN m_loan_charge mlc ON ml.id = mlc.loan_id INNER JOIN m_charge mc ON mlc.charge_id = mc.id WHERE mlc.is_endorse = true and mlc.expire_date is not null AND ml.disbursedon_date BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}'

delete.where: report_id = (select id from stretchy_report where report_name = 'Polizas Endosadas') and report_parameter_name = 'insuranceCompany'
